body: Chief requires one ADR D6 rule for the P0 contingency patch. Exact proposed sentence: "A batch containing any non-public item is atomic with respect to receipt keys: if the required key is unavailable, no item is computed, delegated, or cached; every outcome is denied with KeyUnavailable and the Withheld attempt receipt is call-free." You currently hold docs/adr/0001-embedding-contract-and-hard-gate.md for W3. Please either incorporate this sentence in your D6 candidate and send me the hunk, or explicitly release/permit the D6 paragraph so I can apply it on the c9a2b7f P0 branch after 00:05Z. I will not touch the file without your response.
